## Scope / exclusive ownership
Planning only. Production target: lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_smtp_live.ex, missed lines 47, 150, 184, 252, 258, 330, 407, 414. Exclusive test edit path: test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_smtp_live_test.exs. No production, other test, fixture/support, E2E, or documentation edits in this bead. Parent owns implementation assignment, mix q and targeted --cover; no full suite or coveralls in this task. No test execution or Git mutation in planning.

## Functional specification / test-first scenarios
Write the following focused LiveView integration regressions first, using real BO route /bo/channels/retrieval/email/smtp, authenticated ConnCase, actual Engine settings + Repo + Channels where possible. Use render_click/render_submit, assert rendered flash/status AND persisted state where relevant; do not invoke private functions.
1. L47, select_connector nil: mount with existing SMTP connector; render_submit(view, "select_connector", %{"id" => "nonexistent"}) (or render_click with event params). Assert "Connector not found." flash and original selection/form unchanged. Also invalid identifier must never select another account.
2. L150, generic save error: mount with one valid connector, then delete/archive that connector after mount so cached selected id is stale; submit valid SMTP params. Engine selected_config must reject as :connector_mismatch, not a changeset. Assert "Failed to save email configuration." flash, save-status-error includes :connector_mismatch, and no replacement SMTP connector or plaintext password persisted. Use the public ChannelConfig archive API if available; otherwise Repo.delete! solely as stale-state fixture and document why. Do not alter BO auth or stub Engine.
3. L184, generic activate error: separately mount on enabled/disabled valid connector; archive/delete after mount; click activate. Assert "Failed to update email status." flash, error status contains :connector_mismatch and no new active connector; keep separate from changeset-error test already present.
4. L252, unexpected delivery response: extend existing test-only Sender to return an unexpected atom, e.g. :unexpected_receipt, from configured result; insert enabled connector; submit recipient via form; synchronize on render or :sys.get_state(view.pid), assert exact "Email delivery returned an unexpected response." and no success banner. Before implementing confirm EmailBridge.send_reply and DeliveryConfirmation.record propagate this response rather than raising; if contract differs, record blocker rather than mocking internal modules.
5. L258, rescued exception: extend same edge sender fake with a :raise mode raising a safe constant message; submit on enabled connector, assert rendered error is exactly that message and LiveView remains alive; existing :exit case covers catch, not rescue. Do not leak credentials in exception text.
6. L330, empty retry-detail branch: reuse put_failing_mailer({:retries_exceeded, ""}) with enabled connector; assert exact "Could not reach the SMTP server. " result (trailing separator comes from existing formatter) and no "Details:" text. Prefer current_test_status to preserve whitespace; rendered HTML need only confirm nonempty user-visible summary. Avoid relying on incidental HTML whitespace.
7. L407, non-Event email_settings fallback: NodeRouter.dispatch/1 publicly guarantees %Zaq.Event{} even for service failure; LiveView directly calls concrete module and has no injection seam. Do not monkeypatch NodeRouter or add test-only hook. Real unavailable engine results in %Event{response: {:error, ...}}, so this literal fallback appears unreachable through public contract. Document precise impossibility; if parent finds a production-relevant non-Event boundary, reassess with approved production-meaningful seam, then assert safe error response from public event. Not a coverage-at-any-cost test.
8. L414, pending runtime sync warning: save valid connector, arrange Engine EmailConnectorSettings.save to persist but return runtime {:pending, reason} through a genuine Channels runtime-sync failure, assert persisted connector, #save-status-ok and flash "SMTP settings saved, but runtime sync is pending: <reason>". Evaluate whether an existing request opts/runtime router can be supplied through LiveView: current LiveView email_settings fixes opts to action+confidential, and direct NodeRouter uses no injectable router, so direct deterministic failure injection via Engine API tests does NOT execute LiveView L414. Do not stop global Channels supervisor, change global router config, add a production test-only override, or duplicate fake engine logic. If no supported safe boundary exists, mark L414 blocked and keep existing Engine EmailConnectorSettings.save runtime-pending contract tests as corroboration (no edits outside exclusive path). Parent decides production-meaningful seam separately if coverage is mandatory. Both save and activate pass through maybe_put_runtime_pending; either is enough if safely reachable.

## Fixtures/helpers/mocks/isolation
Reuse current test module setup (AccountsFixtures.user_fixture, password change, init_test_session, ConnCase sandbox, Mox verify_on_exit!, bounded NodeRouterMock.find_node stub), insert_smtp_channel/1 and insert_enabled_smtp_channel/1, put_failing_mailer/1, current_test_status/1, and test-only Sender. For multi-connector selection use Repo.insert! with unique names as existing test. Keep router/Engine/ChannelConfig real. Fake SMTP sender only at existing external mail delivery boundary; no network. If using Mox for a genuine boundary, set per-test exact %Event{} expectations, verify_on_exit!, no blanket router stubs. Existing Sender and secret config mutate application env; preserve async:false / existing non-async ConnCase and restore original values on exit (including smtp_live_test_owner/result/error); avoid new globally visible state. SQL sandbox owns LiveView process via ConnCase; if spawned task needs DB allow its PID explicitly. No sleeps/polls; render, :sys.get_state barrier and assert_receive for sender event. No raw secrets in assertions/logs.

## Property, UX/E2E, action reuse and validation
No property test: these are finitely enumerated UI callbacks/error branches, not an unbounded invariant or normalization/security default. Negative stale-id example protects selection; broader authorization remains existing Engine/BO auth contract. No new-feature E2E authoring: coverage-only existing feature behavior, current unit/LiveView integration tests suffice; system-config E2E execution is governed by parent validation lifecycle and approval gate. Action reuse: not applicable; tests only, no executable operation added/changed; retain existing email_connector_settings Engine event, Channels deliver_outgoing event and ChannelConfig contract, no new Action or tool. Docs to update: none; this Beadwork description carries plan/blockers. Parent validation after implementation: targeted mix test test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_smtp_live_test.exs; mix q; targeted --cover for this module, inspect missed-line map and meaningful assertions; report unreachable 407 and conditionally 414 as documented exceptions, not silent gaps. No full suite or mix coveralls in this bead. Final mix precommit belongs to final human-approval gate, not this planning subtask.

## Dependency / done
One test surface and owner; no implementation dependency edge or additional issue required for this planning-only bead. Ready to hand off. Done when parent receives exact path, reachable scenarios and blockers. Do not claim lines covered before targeted report proves execution.
